hunks.baseline: Sensing those two contradictory sensations, the black knight looked down at the transparent spearhead protruding through his chest.
hunks.sol: Feeling those two contradictory sensations, the black knight looked down at the transparent spearhead protruding from his chest.

hunks.baseline: He slowly raised his head. His gaze met that of a young human wearing an unreadable expression.
hunks.sol: He slowly raised his head. His gaze settled on the young human before him, whose expression he could not read.

hunks.baseline: “Enough now…… rest.”
hunks.sol: “Enough…rest now.”

hunks.baseline: The emotion in the voice was neither mockery toward a defeated opponent nor the joy of a victor. It was bitter—and, in a way, wistful.
hunks.sol: There was neither mockery for the defeated nor a victor’s joy in his voice. It sounded bitter and, in a way, wistful.

hunks.baseline: That one sentence filled the black knight’s mind.
hunks.sol: Those words filled the black knight’s mind.

hunks.baseline: And then, in the next moment—
hunks.sol: Then, in the next moment—

hunks.baseline: The black knight heard the sound of everything binding him shattering apart.
hunks.sol: The black knight heard everything binding him shatter.

hunks.baseline: The jet-black armor that had barely maintained its shape broke into hundreds, thousands of fragments, and the mighty mana within him staggered.
hunks.sol: The jet-black armor that had barely retained its shape broke into hundreds, then thousands of fragments, and the mighty mana within him faltered.

hunks.baseline: *That’s……*
hunks.sol: *That’s…*

hunks.baseline: In a world that had slowed to a crawl, he saw a small, worn child’s shoe through the fragments of armor scattering around him.
hunks.sol: In a world that had slowed to a crawl, he saw a small, worn child’s shoe through the scattering fragments of armor.

hunks.baseline: *“Thank you, Uncle. No…… Father.”*
hunks.sol: *“Thank you, Uncle. No…Father.”*

hunks.baseline: *“Waaah, waaah!”*
hunks.sol: *“Waaah! Waaah!”*

hunks.baseline: *“T-This child……”*
hunks.sol: *“T-This child…”*

hunks.baseline: *“Dada, Momma!”*
hunks.sol: *“Dada! Momma!”*

hunks.baseline: It was a tear that wiped away the dark clouds filling his mind. The tear of a dead man who had finally remembered himself.
hunks.sol: It swept away the dark clouds filling his mind. It was the tear of a dead man who had finally remembered who he was.

hunks.baseline: *Ah…… ahhh……*
hunks.sol: *Ah…ahhh…*

hunks.baseline: The unknown child crying in its parents’ arms overlapped with the image of his daughter, smiling brightly as she saw him off on the morning he died.
hunks.sol: The nameless child crying in its parents’ arms overlapped with the image of his daughter smiling brightly as she saw him off on the morning he died.

hunks.baseline: He thought he had kissed his wife on the forehead and rubbed his face against his daughter’s cheek. He had hugged his daughter as she laughed and complained that his beard was scratchy, then left through the front door.
hunks.sol: He seemed to remember kissing his wife on the forehead and rubbing his face against his daughter’s cheek. He had hugged her as she laughed and complained that his beard was scratchy, then walked out the front door.

hunks.baseline: But that promise was never kept.
hunks.sol: But he never kept that promise.

hunks.baseline: A few hours later, a disaster unlike any seen since the Great Cataclysm began, and he fought with every ounce of strength he possessed. At last, he encountered a certain being.
hunks.sol: A few hours later, a disaster unlike any seen since the Great Cataclysm began. He fought with every ounce of strength he possessed until, at last, he came face-to-face with a certain being.

hunks.baseline: The red glow burning in his eyes faded as if it had been washed away.
hunks.sol: The red glow burning in his eyes vanished as if it had been washed away.

hunks.baseline: The man with cloudy, gray-white eyes was no longer the black knight, nor the Death Knight Lord.
hunks.sol: The man with cloudy, gray-white eyes was no longer the black knight or the Death Knight Lord.

hunks.baseline: The glow of the setting sun shining through the clouds cast a reddish hue over his pale skin.
hunks.sol: The setting sun shining through the clouds cast a reddish hue over his pale skin.

hunks.baseline: The System notification rang out at the exact moment I reached out to deliver the final blow.
hunks.sol: The System notification rang out just as I reached forward to deliver the final blow.

hunks.baseline: My movement abruptly stopped at the unexpected development.
hunks.sol: The unexpected development stopped me cold.

hunks.baseline: The gray-white eyes of the Death Knight Lord—or rather, Lei Fei—who had been staring up at the sky slowly turned toward me. The voice escaping between his lips was hollow and lonely.
hunks.sol: The gray-white eyes of the Death Knight Lord—or rather, Lei Fei—slowly shifted from the sky toward me. The voice that slipped between his lips was hollow and lonely.

hunks.baseline: I had never heard of or seen anything like this before. I stared at him in silence for a moment, then opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: I had never heard of or seen anything like this before. After staring at him in silence, I spoke.

hunks.baseline: Lei Fei looked down at his own hands. They were pale and rotten. Some of his flesh and bone had fallen away during his fierce exchange with me.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei looked down at his hands. They were pale and rotting, with parts of the flesh and bone missing after our fierce battle.

hunks.baseline: And they were soaked in red blood. Human blood.
hunks.sol: They were also soaked in red blood.
Human blood.

hunks.baseline: The man who had once thrown away his life for humanity had become the commander of a monster army and slaughtered humans.
hunks.sol: The man who had sacrificed his life for humanity had become the commander of a monster army and slaughtered humans.

hunks.baseline: I wanted to tell him. *It wasn’t your will. It happened because the Arch Lich’s magic had seized control of your mind.*
hunks.sol: I wanted to tell him. *It wasn’t your will. The Arch Lich’s magic had seized control of your mind.*

hunks.baseline: “You don’t have to say it. I already know what you’re trying to tell me. But……”
hunks.sol: “You don’t have to say it. I already know what you’re trying to tell me. But…”

hunks.baseline: Lei Fei gestured toward his own body and continued.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei gestured toward his body and continued.

hunks.baseline: Everything he said was true. The sturdy body of the undead, which neither steel nor bullets could pierce, was slowly—very slowly—falling apart.
hunks.sol: Everything he said was true. The tough undead body that neither steel nor bullets had been able to pierce was slowly—very slowly—falling apart.

hunks.baseline: And, paradoxically, what was sustaining Lei Fei now was the mana that still remained within his body.
hunks.sol: And paradoxically, the only thing sustaining Lei Fei now was the mana still remaining within him.

hunks.baseline: “It’s ridiculous. I became an undead and killed humans, yet I’m clinging to existence with that very power.”
hunks.sol: “It’s ridiculous. I became one of the undead and killed humans, yet I’m holding on with that very power.”

hunks.baseline: After muttering hollowly, he spoke to me.
hunks.sol: After muttering hollowly, he turned to me.

hunks.baseline: “……Please, go ahead.”
hunks.sol: “…Please, go ahead.”

hunks.baseline: I thought Lei Fei wanted to disappear. I assumed he wished to find rest and escape from everything that had caused him pain.
hunks.sol: I thought Lei Fei wanted Erasure. I assumed he wished to find rest and escape from all his pain.

hunks.baseline: But the words that slipped from his lips in the next moment were completely different from what I expected.
hunks.sol: But the words that slipped from his lips were nothing like what I expected.

hunks.baseline: “I swore an oath on the day I became a Hunter. I swore that I would fight monsters until the moment my life ended. That oath is still valid.”
hunks.sol: “I swore an oath on the day I became a Hunter. I swore that I would fight monsters until the moment my life ended. That oath still stands.”

hunks.baseline: Lei Fei had already fulfilled his mission. He had charged forward bravely and shattered magnificently.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei had already fulfilled his mission. He had charged forward bravely and met a glorious end.

hunks.baseline: The one who had fought humanity after becoming a Death Knight Lord had been acting on the Arch Lich’s will, not his own.
hunks.sol: When he fought humanity as the Death Knight Lord, he had been acting on the Arch Lich’s will, not his own.

hunks.baseline: And yet, even now, he wanted to fight again. Though his life had already ended, he stood tall once more, reaffirming his mission.
hunks.sol: And yet he wanted to fight again. Though his life had already ended, he stood tall once more and reaffirmed his mission.

hunks.baseline: That was why I could not help asking.
hunks.sol: That was why I had to ask.

hunks.baseline: At my question, Lei Fei smiled faintly.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei smiled faintly.

hunks.baseline: “Why did you come running here alone, even though countless monsters and dangers were waiting for you? And why am I trying to fight until the very end? What’s the difference?”
hunks.sol: “Why did you come running here alone, knowing that countless monsters and dangers awaited you? Why am I trying to fight until the very end? What’s the difference?”

hunks.baseline: I knew the answer.
hunks.sol: I already knew the answer.

hunks.baseline: Lei Fei looked at me, unable to speak, then raised his hand and gestured around us.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei looked at me as I stood speechless, then raised a hand and gestured around us.

hunks.baseline: The countless monster troops that still remained were reflected in his eyes, which had already lost the light of life.
hunks.sol: The countless monsters still remaining on the battlefield were reflected in his eyes, which had already lost the light of life.

hunks.baseline: “This…… will be my final battle.”
hunks.sol: “This…will be my final battle.”

hunks.baseline: Lei Fei pulled White Flame from his own chest and handed it to me, then raised his sword.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei pulled White Flame from his chest and handed it to me, then raised his sword.

hunks.baseline: Instead of the dazzling aura blade symbolizing an S-rank Hunter, ominous dark mana coiled around the blade and surged upward.
hunks.sol: Instead of the dazzling aura blade that symbolized an S-rank Hunter, ominous dark mana coiled around the blade and surged upward.

hunks.baseline: It was a Hunter burning through his final mission.
hunks.sol: He was a Hunter burning through the last of his life to fulfill his mission.

hunks.baseline: “I’d like to fight together. But will they allow me?”
hunks.sol: “I’d like to fight alongside them. But will they allow me?”

hunks.baseline: Anyone who heard those words without knowing the circumstances would have dismissed them as random nonsense.
hunks.sol: Anyone who did not know the circumstances would have dismissed his words as nonsense.

hunks.baseline: But I understood Lei Fei. Angling the spearhead of White Flame downward, I answered.
hunks.sol: But I understood what Lei Fei meant. Lowering White Flame’s spearhead at an angle, I answered.

hunks.baseline: “They’ll be happy. If they’re the people I know.”
hunks.sol: “They’ll be glad. If they’re the people I know.”

hunks.baseline: “……You think the same way I do.”
hunks.sol: “…That’s what I thought.”

hunks.baseline: The mana he had dragged forth with all his strength seeped across the battlefield. Then a thunderous cry burst from his lips.
hunks.sol: The mana he drew out with all his remaining strength seeped across the battlefield. Then a thunderous cry burst from his lips.

hunks.baseline: At the call of the Death Knight Lord—or rather, the head of the Public Security Armed Forces Department—the hundreds of Hunters who had fallen across the battlefield rose to their feet. They had returned from death as undead, and now they gripped their weapons and gathered in one place.
hunks.sol: At the call of the Death Knight Lord—or rather, the head of the Public Security Armed Forces Department—the hundreds of Hunters who had fallen across the battlefield rose to their feet. Returned from death, they gripped their weapons and assembled in one place.

hunks.baseline: At their apex stood Lei Fei and me.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei and I stood at their head.

hunks.baseline: As if bewitched, I stepped forward.
hunks.sol: As though bewitched, I stepped forward.

hunks.baseline: The monster army, which had been thrown into confusion by the unexpected turn of events, finally gathered together, spewing hostile cries.
hunks.sol: The monster army, thrown into confusion by the unexpected turn of events, finally gathered with savage roars.

hunks.baseline: Toward the commander who had now become their enemy.
hunks.sol: They came for the commander who had become their enemy.

hunks.baseline: And toward me, standing at the front.
hunks.sol: And for me, standing at the front.

hunks.baseline: I walked slowly but firmly.
hunks.sol: I walked forward, slowly but firmly.

hunks.baseline: It did not take long for the ripples spreading across the water to become waves and crash over them.
hunks.sol: It did not take long for the ripples to become a wave and crash over the enemy.

hunks.baseline: And at the entrance to what would be our final battle, Lei Fei shouted at the top of his lungs.
hunks.sol: At the threshold of what would be their final battle, Lei Fei shouted at the top of his lungs.

hunks.baseline: That was the cry that had echoed through the footage.
hunks.sol: It was the same cry that had echoed through the footage.

hunks.baseline: On their battered, filthy armor, the Five-Starred Red Flag—their symbol and pride—shone in the glow of the setting sun.
hunks.sol: The Five-Starred Red Flag—their symbol and their pride—shone in the setting sun upon their battered, filthy armor.

hunks.baseline: Clutching my throbbing chest, I shot toward the monsters like a ray of light.
hunks.sol: With my chest throbbing, I became a streak of light and shot toward the monsters.

hunks.baseline: I had no idea. Like someone possessed, I kept moving forward. I smashed, cut, stabbed, and blew apart everything that stood in my way.
hunks.sol: I had no idea. Like a man possessed, I kept moving forward. I smashed, cut, stabbed, and blew apart everything that stood in my way.

hunks.baseline: Blue hellfire surged upward like pillars, and monsters engulfed in flames that would not go out screamed.
hunks.sol: Blue hellfire surged upward in pillars, and monsters engulfed in flames that would not go out screamed.

hunks.baseline: Then, when nothing could be heard anymore, I suddenly stopped where I stood.
hunks.sol: Then, when I could no longer hear anything, I suddenly stopped.

hunks.baseline: Feeling the fatigue I had momentarily forgotten come crashing back over me, I looked around.
hunks.sol: The fatigue I had briefly forgotten came crashing back over me as I looked around.

hunks.baseline: Across the wide expanse of land, there were no monsters left standing.
hunks.sol: Across the vast expanse of land, not a single monster remained standing.

hunks.baseline: Not the ogres and Trolls that had spewed their hostile cries, nor the Wyverns and Gargoyles that had circled through the air.
hunks.sol: Neither the ogres and Trolls that had bellowed their savage cries nor the Wyverns and Gargoyles that had circled overhead.

hunks.baseline: And……
hunks.sol: And…

hunks.baseline: Thud. Collapse!
hunks.sol: Thud. Thump!

hunks.baseline: Not even the Public Security Armed Forces Department Hunters who had been resurrected as undead.
hunks.sol: The Public Security Armed Forces Department Hunters resurrected as undead began to fall as well.

hunks.baseline: Having fulfilled their final mission, they fell one after another like puppets whose strings had been cut.
hunks.sol: Having fulfilled their final mission, they collapsed one after another like puppets whose strings had been cut.

hunks.baseline: As I stared at them with indescribable emotions, I realized what their collapse meant.
hunks.sol: As I watched them with an emotion I could not put into words, I realized what their collapse meant.

hunks.baseline: “……Lei Fei!”
hunks.sol: “…Lei Fei!”

hunks.baseline: He was sitting in the middle of the silent battlefield. One arm had been severed, and his side had been torn open, yet he waited for me with a peaceful expression.
hunks.sol: He sat in the middle of the silent battlefield. One arm had been severed and his side torn open, yet he waited for me with a peaceful expression.

hunks.baseline: I did not know why, but that insignificant sentence made something surge up inside my chest.
hunks.sol: I did not know why, but those simple words made something surge up inside my chest.

hunks.baseline: I had not known him for ten years, yet a curse slipped from my lips before I could stop it.
hunks.sol: We had not even known each other for ten years, yet a curse slipped from my lips before I could stop it.

hunks.baseline: “Damn it……”
hunks.sol: “Damn it…”

hunks.baseline: Lei Fei gave a quiet laugh as he spoke. He already knew who I was.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei let out a quiet laugh. He already knew who I was.

hunks.baseline: “Is that really the problem right now? There has to be some way……”
hunks.sol: “Is that really the problem right now? There has to be some way…”

hunks.baseline: The owner of the voice, much deeper and more subdued than usual, was the Skeleton Warlord.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton Warlord’s voice was deeper and more subdued than usual.

hunks.baseline: Lei Fei looked at him with wide eyes.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei stared at him, eyes widening.

hunks.baseline: —I am the commander. You are a foolish but somewhat remarkable human.
hunks.sol: —I am a commander, foolish but somewhat remarkable human.

hunks.baseline: “You are a monster, then. I have no idea what’s going on, but…… yes, if you’re Jin Taekyung, I’m sure you’ll handle it somehow.”
hunks.sol: “A monster, then. I have no idea what’s going on, but…yes, if you’re Jin Taekyung, I’m sure you’ll handle it somehow.”

hunks.baseline: Lei Fei nodded, then raised his head toward the sky. His slowly blinking gray-white eyes reflected a sky stained entirely red.
hunks.sol: Lei Fei nodded and raised his head toward the sky. His slowly blinking gray-white eyes reflected the sky, now stained entirely red.

hunks.baseline: I did not ask the foolish question of *to whom?* I already knew who he meant.
hunks.sol: I did not ask the foolish question, *To whom?*
I already knew.

hunks.baseline: “Tell them I love them. And tell them I’m sorry I couldn’t return.”
hunks.sol: “Tell them I love them. And tell them I’m sorry I couldn’t come home.”

hunks.baseline: Feeling my chest churn, I answered.
hunks.sol: My chest churning, I answered.

hunks.baseline: “……I will.”
hunks.sol: “…I will.”

hunks.baseline: With a dry, crumbling sound, his fingers broke apart into dust. Soon, his arm, his leg, his chest……
hunks.sol: With a dry, crumbling sound, his fingers broke apart into dust. Then his arm, his leg, his chest…

hunks.baseline: At the very end, a single sentence slipped between his lips.
hunks.sol: At the very end, one last sentence slipped between his lips.

hunks.baseline: The wind blew. The hero who had turned into a handful of dust scattered through the air.
hunks.sol: The wind blew. The hero, reduced to a handful of dust, scattered into the air.

hunks.baseline: I stared blankly at the sight. Then I saw dozens of aircraft flying toward us in formation.
hunks.sol: As I stared blankly at the sight, dozens of planes appeared in my field of vision, flying toward us in formation.
